content.comment_body: Hello! I recently acquired a new [product_name] [version_no]. I have a class 10 SD card with 16GB capacity. The [product_name] reports a read error but my PC can access the card without issue. I tried reformatting it multiple times using FAT32, with both slow and fast formatting options. When I insert the card and check diagnostics, the [product_name] initially says the card is fine, but uploading a program leads to a diagnostics message about SD card read/write error. This started when trying to upload an [product_name] Web Editor program. Any suggestions?

I use a variety of SD cards from different brands, classes, and capacities (2GB to 64GB) in my [product_name] devices. I've never encountered issues, though with the 64GB card, I had to set up a 32GB FAT32 partition since the [product_name] supports up to 32GB. All the cards are formatted with FAT32.

From my experience with [product_name] [version_no] and microSD cards, reliability has been inconsistent and not up to industrial standards. The microSD, a Maxell microSD HC class 10 16GB, was formatted as FAT32 with various allocation sizes, but upon insertion, diagnostics say the microSD is okay, only to show an error during program loading. The PC can deploy the [product_name] Web Editor program and handle large files with no problems. It appears to be an incompatibility between the [product_name] and this specific card. I later tried a 32GB U1 card, and that one worked successfully. In my view, this is a [product_name] issue that needs addressing, particularly since lower class SD cards are becoming hard to find. I’d like to know if anyone can explain how to extract diagnostics or error logs from the [product_name] to determine why it fails to write to the SD card.
Sorry, I can't add anything beyond what I've already shared. For me, this doesn't seem to be a [product_name] problem. You could reach out to [company_name] through a Support Request.
Thanks. I'll do that. There's definitely something unusual happening with my [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are reporting unreliable compatibility between SD cards and the [product_name] [version_no], with the device occasionally unable to read or write even when the SD card works fine on a PC. Some users have trouble especially when loading programs like the [product_name] Web Editor, noting that overall reliability falls short of industrial expectations. Troubleshooting is hindered by limited diagnostics information provided by the device.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] [version_no] to consistently detect and use standard SD cards and to have clear, comprehensive diagnostic or logging support to easily understand SD card errors.
